verdicts.evidence: The page reads "Monday to Friday, nine to eight", "Saturday, ten to four", "Tuesday to Friday, ten to six" and "Saturday, ten to two", all written out in words with no numerals and no am or pm.
Neither branch lists Sunday, Harbour branch does not list Monday, and the mobile library lines give only "Wednesday at the market square" and "Thursday at the school gates" with no times.
The baselines of the subheads and the hours lines fall at about y=143, 188, 233, 278, 323, 368, 413, 458 and 503, so every line is about 45 px from the next, including the gap above each subhead.
The hours are set as loose left-aligned sentences with no columns, and the right two-thirds of the screen is empty.
